title: Workday plan: buckthorn below Hillcrest
summary: Saturday's plan, what to bring and where the brush piles go.
body:
We are clearing buckthorn from plot W4, the slope below the overlook. Cut stems are painted with herbicide by the licensed crew member only; volunteers cut and drag.

Brush piles go at the marked stakes along the Ridge Trail. The crew will chip them on Monday.

title: Tool shed: winter inventory
zone: Tool shed by the North Gate
summary: What we have, what is broken and what we are buying before spring.
body: We have 22 pairs of loppers (4 need new blades), 30 pairs of gloves in mixed sizes, 6 weed wrenches and 2 wheelbarrows. Please return tools cleaned and log them on the sheet by the door.

title: Minutes: Friends board, October
summary: Playground pledge, the prairie plan and next year's workday calendar.
body: 1. The board confirmed the $240,000 playground pledge, with $198,500 raised to date. 2. The prairie plan goes to the city for review in January. 3. Twelve workdays planned for 2027.

title: Safety: working near water
summary: Rules for workdays on the Wallow shore and Tanner's Run.
body: Work in pairs within ten feet of water. Throw bags are in the blue box at every shoreline worksite. No volunteer goes onto ice for any reason.

title: Work order 2611: boardwalk handrail, section 2
summary: Loose handrail post at the second bird blind.
body: Tighten or replace post 2-17 and check posts 2-14 to 2-20. Priority: this week.

title: Work order 2614: winterize Meadow Restrooms
summary: Drain lines, add antifreeze to traps, post the closure sign.
body: Completed Nov 2 by the south crew. Signed off.

title: Work order 2617: leaf collection, Wallow Loop
summary: Weekday mornings until the loop is clear.
body: Truck enters at the South Gate at 7:00 am. Cones at each end of the working section.

title: Crew rota: November 16 – 29
summary: Who opens, who locks and who is on ice watch.
body: Opening (5:00 am): Ortiz, Haddad. Locking (11:00 pm): Brandt, Mwangi. Ice watch begins Dec 1.

title: Winter closure plan: the Wallow and the woods
summary: Ice rules, the warming hut, plowing order and when to close the woods trails.
body: Ice: measure at five marked points; post open only at 5 inches of clear ice everywhere. Plow order: Perimeter Path, Wallow Loop, Elm Walk, parking. Woods trails close in ice storms.

title: Safety: chainsaw work near the public
body: Two tree-lengths exclusion zone, a spotter at each path approach and signs at both ends.
